messages:
sara_pm: Heads up — marketplace onboarding for ZeptoCloud pilot is slipping 2–3 weeks due to a supplier manifest mismatch. Need to discuss capacity guardrails for the joint announcement.
ryan_ops: ugh. is this a customs hold or dock delay?
orion_supply: vendor flagged an SKU split in the manifest, shipping provider paused the pallet until we confirm serials. ETA unclear.
lia_partnerships: timeline impact on the customer launch or just availability for Dedicated resv?
sara_pm: both. we promised marketplace availability coincident with our marketing email. If hardware doesn't clear, we risk a limited launch and confused messaging.
ben_infra: from infra side, we can soften the announcement: show "available in select regions" and enable a private beta toggle for affected accounts. low-dev effort.
ryan_ops: ops ask: can we borrow buffer from upcoming EU rack arrivals? I see a small QTY arriving next week that could reallocate. Need partner sign-off.
orion_supply: we can request a one-time reassign but vendor charges cross-dock fees. i'll ping them now. manifest-bot: Automated update: manifest_v3.csv shows 14 SKUs flagged; hold reason: serial mismatch. Ticket #MC-8843 created.
sara_pm: ok, plan proposal: 1) update landing copy to "select regions" 2) reassign 8 racks from next week's EU arrival to marketplace backlog 3) offer affected customers early access on Dedicated with a credit if delayed >2 weeks 4) notify PR to hold the full announcement pending final ETA.
lia_partnerships: prioritize customer impact. can we map which enterprise pilots are affected? ryan, ben — can you run a quick inventory to identify booked Dedicated resv that overlap?
ryan_ops: running a query now, will post summary in 15. if we reassign 8 racks, infra can provision a "soft reserve" to honor pilot deals.
orion_supply: vendor replied — they'll release 6 racks by tomorrow if we accept cross-dock fee and sign amended delivery window. remaining 2 racks are stuck at origin until serial reconciliation next week.
ben_infra: makes sense. if we take the 6, that covers most pilots. For the remaining shortfall, enable fallback routing to US pool for low-latency tolerant customers.
sara_pm: thanks. lia, can you draft a short customer comms snippet? keep it reassuring and offer credits. i'll update marketing and PR ask.
lia_partnerships: on it. draft: "We're enabling select-region access today; a small set of customers may see a delayed availability due to partner shipping. We're offering early Dedicated access or a service credit — DM to opt in"
ryan_ops: inventory summary: 9 pilot commitments affected; 7 can be covered by the 6 immediate racks + fallback, 2 will need credits or delayed start.
sara_pm: good — action items: orion to accept cross-dock fee and confirm release (by EOD), ben to configure soft reserves, ryan to tag affected accounts and notify CSMs, lia to send comms draft to legal and PR. meet in 2h for status. :thumbsup:
orion_supply: accepted. vendor will invoice cross-dock fee. releasing 6 racks now, tracking #MC-8843 updated.
manifest-bot: Update: manifest_v3.csv -> released: 6, pending: 8, flagged: 0.
lia_partnerships: sending comms to legal now. will post final copy here.
sara_pm: thanks all. small ask to marketing: hold full launch hero until we confirm final 2 racks. we'll maintain momentum with a blog about architecture instead.
ben_infra: noted, will stand up fallback routing and soft reserve policy template. pushing config change to staging. code snippet for soft reserve tagging: ```
# tag allocation
alloc --region eu --tag marketplace_soft_reserve --qty 8
```
ryan_ops: if anything else, ping me in #release-war-room. I'll update the pilot owners.
lia_partnerships: legal flagged the credit wording — suggest "service credit up to one month". PR also ok with select-region phrasing.
sara_pm: final: proceed with the 6-rack release, update site to "select regions", CSM outreach for 9 pilots, postpone hero announcement. reconvene if any further slippage. :white_check_mark:
